title: Long-lived cache headers for public/ assets and a lighter deploy tree (111 MB, three music tracks, 30 MB of theme images)

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: next.config.ts:369-373 sets Cache-Control only for /brand, /fonts, /icons, /images. public/ also holds themes/, sites/, themes-index/, create-a-space/, screenshots/, maplibre/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs (519KB), frequency-wordmark.png; du: themes 30M, sites 27M, themes-index 9.5M. Next serves those at its default (revalidate every request). || du -sh public/*: themes 30M, brand 19M, tracks 14M (drift.mp3 5.8 MB, forest.mp3 5.3 MB, ocean.mp3 2.7 MB), images 11M, themes-index 9.5M. Largest images are 500-600 KB webp/jpg.

WHY IT MATTERS: Repeat visits and the map worker re-validate on every load; any direct (non-optimizer) reference re-downloads 300-600KB files. Modest repeat-view and map-open lift. Static files are served from the CDN, but they bloat clones and Vercel upload; the tracks suggest an audio feature whose loading cost should be checked.

FIX DIRECTION: Add the same week+SWR header for /themes, /sites, /themes-index, /create-a-space, /screenshots, /maplibre (rename-to-replace, like /brand). Move tracks to Blob/Storage, keep only used theme shots.

PARTLY DONE 2026-11-16, row stays open. Shipped: the week plus stale-while-revalidate header now covers the images in public/themes, public/sites, public/create-a-space, public/themes-index and public/screenshots (next.config.ts), pinned by scripts/static-cache-headers.test.ts. Three corrections to the fix direction. (1) /themes, /sites and /create-a-space are also page routes, so a plain /themes/:path* rule would have cached HTML such as /themes/nocturne in the browser for a week; those three rules match image extensions only and the test proves no page gets the header. (2) /maplibre is left out on purpose: scripts/copy-maplibre-worker.mjs copies the two worker files unhashed on every build and they change in place on a maplibre-gl bump, so a week of cache would create the stale-worker skew that script exists to prevent. Caching it safely needs a versioned URL first. (3) public/tracks is live: lib/on-air.ts serves /tracks/forest.mp3, ocean.mp3 and drift.mp3 to the audio player, and next.config.ts already keeps them out of every function trace, so they cost clone and upload size only. Moving them to Blob or Storage needs an upload and a decision on the licensed audio, which was not done here. No theme or site image was deleted: rows in the database can point at them and that was not checked. PROBE FAULT: the first half of this row's check in scripts/probes/audit-2026-11-16.mjs is a JavaScript syntax error (unbalanced quotes in the includes() call), so it exits 1 whatever the tree holds, and it also asks for a /maplibre/ rule and a bare /themes/:path* rule, which are the two things that should not ship. The check needs a rewrite before this row can close.

CHECK REWRITTEN 2026-11-16 (Daniel approved the rewrite at 15:02Z), ROW STAYS OPEN. The check no longer reads next.config.ts as text. It loads the config the way Next does and reads the Cache-Control each URL is served. Cache half: GREEN. All 641 tracked files under public/themes, public/sites, public/themes-index, public/create-a-space and public/screenshots get a week or more; none of eight pages beside them (/themes, /themes/nocturne, /sites/<slug>, /create-a-space and so on) gets a cache header. On the tree before #5031 the same check reads 0 of 641. The /maplibre rule is no longer asked for. Tree half: RED, and it is the real remainder. public/tracks is 13,822 KB against the 1,000 KB the audit set. WHAT IS MISSING TO CLOSE: move forest.mp3, ocean.mp3 and drift.mp3 out of the repo (Blob or Storage), repoint lib/on-air.ts, which needs an upload and the owner's word on the licensed audio. Pruning unused theme shots is also undone and is not measured by the check.

verify.note: Rewritten 2026-11-16 with Daniel's approval (15:02Z). Loads next.config.ts through Next's own loader. Passes when every tracked file in the five public art folders is served a public Cache-Control of a week or more, no page beside them gets one, and public/tracks is under 1000 KB. Red on 2026-11-16 on the tracks clause only (13,822 KB).
